hook: A surgery that costs *Rs 10 lakh+* privately was done free at Gandhi Hospital
hook_b: A surgery that costs *Rs 10 lakh+* privately was done free at Gandhi Hospital
tldr: Gandhi Hospital doctors performed a free cochlear implant on an eight-year-old from Nizamabad with congenital hearing loss, funded by CMRF.

beats.what: Doctors at Gandhi Hospital performed cochlear implant surgery on an eight-year-old boy from Nizamabad with congenital hearing loss on Thursday.
beats.why: The implant was sponsored by the Chief Minister's Relief Fund, superintendent T. Usha Rani said.
beats.care: A speech processor will be fitted about four weeks after healing, followed by over a year of free auditory verbal therapy.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Meenakshi Venkataraman Foundation will give the therapy free at the hospital, ENT head K. Nagaraju said.

cards.q: Should more costly surgeries be offered free at govt hospitals via CMRF?

qs: How many children are waiting for implants in Telangana?
How does CMRF pick which surgeries to fund?

facts.t: Gandhi Hospital has given implants to a little over *28* children since 2025.

viz.verdict: A family avoids a Rs 10 lakh+ private bill.

learn.t: Cochlear implant = a device placed in the ear that sends sound signals straight to the hearing nerve

watch: The external speech processor is fitted about four weeks after healing.
